profile.headline: Consultant at Capco | Software Engineer & QA Automation Lead | Platform Quality Architect | 5x AWS & Azure AI Certified | Enterprise FinTech Pipeline Engineering | Expert in Java, Python, NodeJS
profile.summary:
I systems engineer, maximize software quality, and design secure automation platforms across cloud-native environments. 

With over 14 years of professional experience across FinTech, enterprise banking, and high-scale energy operations, I operate comfortably at the intersection of full-stack software development, advanced test automation architecture, and cloud infrastructure operations.

My unique perspective stems from a rigorous systems engineering background and a Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, combined with six active AWS certifications and an Azure AI credential. This architectural foundation allows me to view software ecosystems not merely as isolated applications, but as complex, distributed networks requiring continuous monitoring, precise fault isolation, and highly parallelized testing strategies.

Whether architecting end-to-end regression frameworks in Java and Selenium that save hundreds of engineering hours for major consumer lending institutions like Huntington Bank, building serverless microservices in NodeJS, or optimization control configurations for massive industrial infrastructure portfolios, my focus remains unchanged: driving deployment velocity while eliminating operational risk.

Core Competencies & Technical Domain Expertise:
• Software Quality Engineering: Advanced Test Framework Design (UI/API), Test Execution Gating, Defect Leakage Mitigation
• Core Development Technologies: Java, Python, NodeJS, Ruby, Scripting Automations, SQL Query Optimization
• Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: 5x AWS Certified, Container Orchestration (AWS ECS/EKS), Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
• Quality Assurance Methodologies: SAFe Scrum Master/Product Owner, Continuous Integration Gating, Risk-Based Test Architecture
• Advanced Reliability Systems: Root-Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA), Systems Safety Design, Operational Compliance.

I thrive when lead technical teams, constructing foundational testing tools, and breaking down communication silos between software engineers, cloud architects, and business stake owners to ensure robust, enterprise-grade delivery models.

Let’s connect to explore modern SDET Architecture, Cloud Native Test Gating, or Distributed Quality Governance.
